note: Total pet XP needed to reach a pet's maximum level, by rarity. A pet at its maximum level is worth one extra point of pet score on top of its rarity, and this is the only thing the planner needs a level for — so the thresholds are carried rather than the whole per-level curve.
source: Derived from the published pet level curve (PET_LEVELS) and its per-rarity offsets, as carried by SkyCrypt: https://github.com/SkyCryptWebsite/SkyCrypt/blob/master/src/constants/pets.js
derivation: A pet of rarity R reaches level L once its exp covers PET_LEVELS[offset[R] .. offset[R] + L - 2]. maxLevelXp[R] is that sum for L = 100. Cross-checked against the figures the community publishes: common 5,624,785 and legendary 25,353,230 both agree.

GOLDEN_DRAGON.why: The one pet that climbs past 100. It hatches at level 100 and tops out at 200, on the legendary stretch of the same curve.

BINGO.why: Levels on the common stretch of the curve whatever rarity the pet itself is. Not in this app's catalogue, but a player can own one and it still counts towards their score.

ignoredWhy: The game does not count it. It is not in this app's pet catalogue either, but a profile can hold one, so it has to be left out of the score computed from that profile.
